L-02 Main-tree router identity: the paper says Opus 4.8 routes the main results, but no log names it; gpt-4o-mini main-tree tags are iter4-synthesis-handspec 1,774, iter2-synthesis-handspec 178 (github II 162 + none 16, 2026-06-16) and final-opus 63 (2026-08-12); the reported GPT-4o-mini github arm mixes code states (verify/rope.md §6).
